front.title: PCEP Extension for SRv6 Flow Specification

abstract.t: This document specifies extensions to the Path Computation Element Communication Protocol (PCEP) to support Flow Specification for Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6). Building upon the PCEP Flow Specification framework defined in RFC 9168, this specification introduces new PCEP Flow Specification TLVs to enable filtering and steering of IPv6 packets based on the structural components of standard SRv6 Segment Identifiers (SIDs) or SRv6 Compressed SID (CSID) containers present in IPv6 Destination Addresses or Segment Routing Headers (SRH).
